press_references.value: A Safer Path to “Ozempic”: Vitable Health Challenges the “Prescription-First” Trend with a GLP-1 Program Built on Primary Care

product_launches.description: Vitable Health launched a GLP-1-based weight management program and comprehensive preventative lab panels, integrated into its Direct Primary Care services for employer-sponsored members. The program emphasizes safety, ongoing support, and evidence-based care, distinguishing it from prescription-first telehealth models.

overview_description.description: Vitable Health provides an integrated primary care and urgent care health plan designed for accessibility and affordability. The membership includes virtual and in-home visits, mental health support, and access to free prescriptions. This model empowers employers to enhance their healthcare offerings while reducing costs and improving employee satisfaction.

about_short_description.short_description: Vitable Health offers primary care and mental health services through membership.

product.name: Vitable Primary Care
product.description: A virtual direct primary care membership providing unlimited routine visits, preventive care, mental health support, routine labs, care navigation, and free or discounted prescriptions without copays or deductibles.

product.name: ICHRA (Individual Coverage Health Reimbursement Arrangement)
product.description: An employer-sponsored reimbursement solution that lets businesses set tax-free monthly health benefit budgets while employees choose individual insurance plans, with Vitable Primary Care included.

product.name: Minimum Essential Coverage (MEC)
product.description: An ACA-oriented health benefits plan that provides minimum essential coverage and preventive services, paired with Vitable Primary Care for broader access to everyday care.

identifier.value: QSEHRA (Qualified Small Employer Health Reimbursement Arrangement)

product.name: QSEHRA (Qualified Small Employer Health Reimbursement Arrangement)
product.description: A tax-advantaged reimbursement arrangement for small employers that provides employees with funds for eligible individual health expenses and includes Vitable Primary Care.

product.name: ACA Autopilot
product.description: A managed ACA compliance service that tracks employee eligibility, automates benefit offers and IRS codes, handles filings, and provides reporting and audit support for variable-hour workforces.

product.name: Mental Health
product.description: An integrated virtual mental health service offering coaching, counseling, therapy options, medication management, and tools for common concerns such as anxiety, stress, grief, and trauma.
